summary: Iter 12 — Daily Chat refinements e2e testing. Backend pytest 5/5 PASS: (1) GET /api/settings returns dc_reminder_hours List[int] (default [9,12,15,18,21] or persisted), (2) PUT /api/settings roundtrips dc_reminder_hours=[10,14,20] via PUT response body AND subsequent GET, (3) POST /api/settings/test-dc-telegram with empty dc_telegram_bot_token returns 400 'Daily Chat Telegram belum dikonfigurasi', (4) POST /api/settings/test-dc-telegram with fake creds returns 400 'Gagal kirim pesan test' (telegram API rejects), (5) talent user gets 403 on the test-dc-telegram endpoint. Frontend Playwright: admin login OK; nav order confirmed = Dashboard→DailyChat→Orders→Board→ToDo→Performance→Invoice→Earning→Freelance with nav-dashboard immediately before nav-daily-chat and nav-orders immediately after; /daily-chat page loads; dc-month-filter present with current month (2026-05); week-chip-2026-05-W1..W5 all 5 chips rendered; stat-discussing click sets status-filter→'Discussing' AND adds ring/active class, 2nd click reverts to 'all'; stat-place click sets 'Place Order'; stat-followup click sets 'Follow Up' (just FU, not nego); stat-total + stat-conv are DIV (not BUTTON) with cursor=auto (non-clickable confirmed), while stat-discussing is a BUTTON; auto-fill verified: add row → fill row-agreed with '100' + blur → row-real displays '80' AND backend GET /api/daily-chats returns that row with agreed=100 real=80; Settings page: test-dc-telegram-btn present, dc-reminder-hours-input defaults to '9, 12, 15, 18, 21', changing to '10, 14, 20' + save + reload persists as '10, 14, 20'. All spec behaviors pass. No blocking bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: DailyChat.jsx L227: Follow Up StatCard uses active={statusFilter === 'Follow Up'} but onClick passes 'follow_nego' which toggleStatusFilter maps internally to 'Follow Up'. Works correctly but the indirection is confusing — consider passing 'Follow Up' directly and deleting the 'follow_nego' special case (the comment at L148 even says 'easiest: cycle Follow Up only'). Minor cleanup.

Settings.jsx main save button at L264 'Simpan Settings' has no data-testid — add data-testid='settings-save-btn' for robust automation (my test fell back to button:has-text('Simpan') which is less stable).
server.py L1319-1340 test_dc_telegram endpoint: correctly raises 400 for missing creds AND for telegram failure. Using fallback sample chats when DB empty is a nice UX touch for preview. No issues.

server.py L1577: hours = set(settings_doc.get('dc_reminder_hours') or [9,12,15,18,21]) — uses `or` so empty list falls back to default. If user explicitly wants to disable reminders they should toggle dc_reminders_enabled=false instead — acceptable (L1576 likely checks this). No bug but worth documenting.

DailyChat.jsx patchChat L163: computedReal = Math.round(agreedVal * 0.8 * 100) / 100 — allows 2-decimal precision (e.g., 10 → 8.00); for agreed=100 produces exactly 80, confirmed. For fractional agreed like 99 → 79.2, which is displayed correctly in NumInput. No issue.
WebSocket /api/ws still returns 403 in preview env (pre-existing, flagged in iter 11) — non-blocking, real-time updates won't work in preview but HTTP API + polling work fine.
